_schema: Same as handoff-minotaur-v2 weapons.json. pivotX/pivotY = grip in weapon px; baseAngle = direction the weapon points in its own image (screen degrees, 0=right, 90=down, -90=up). Draw: translate(anchor.x,anchor.y); rotate((anchor.angle-baseAngle) deg); scale(anchor.scale); drawImage(img,-pivotX,-pivotY). behind=true -> draw before the body.
_scale: Authored at 145 px/m so that at anchor scale 0.72 they match the human 3D render (~104.7 px/m in the 180 frame).

iron_sword.note: arming sword ~0.95 m; pivot = centre of leather grip

mace.note: flanged iron head on oak haft ~0.78 m; pivot = centre of leather wrap

oak_staff.note: gnarled oak staff ~1.55 m, brass ring + iron ferrule; pivot = leather wrap ~40% up

round_shield.note: 0.62 m planked round shield, red face, iron rim/boss; pivot = boss centre (hand on the rear grip). Use offHand anchor, no rotation (baseAngle 0, offHand.angle 0).
